## PiTTy v0.6.37

This patch hardens slow extension-heavy setups and bounds diagnostics.

- Default PiTTy RPC response timeout: **30 s → 60 s**.
- Explicit startup/history deadlines and automatic-compaction timeout pausing are unchanged.
- PiTTy run logs are capped at **64 MiB each** and retained diagnostics at **256 MiB total**, preventing long-running sessions from accumulating unbounded diagnostic data.
- mistrjirka/pi-subagent was fixed upstream so its initial child startup handshake gets **60 s** while normal child RPC calls stay at **10 s**.

If git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent is already installed, refresh it once with:

    pi update git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent
